source.description: Candidate source plus the phase-two transfer; not a final release commit.

sanitization: Only software test results are retained. Research paths, titles, source-file inventories, document content and screenshots are excluded.

checks.name: create Main Story and two sections through the editor
create two presentations sharing chapter and repeated page references
ordinary edits create no named versions and the history UI explicitly records milestones
project draft survives tab changes and blocks presentation and export
pin two named versions and save occurrence-specific speaker notes through UI
reopen and navigate distinct live and pinned occurrences in the thumbnail rail
play resolved order with repeated pages and occurrence-specific notes
UI exports each selected presentation with correct count and leaves canonical pages intact
removed canonical page retains references and blocks affected presentation until restored
external project update preserves a conflicting draft and disables overwriting controls
Page Story draft survives object selection and page changes until explicitly saved

note: This is the phase-two rerun using the development Electron host and production bundle. The first integration receipt remains separate; final packaged acceptance is still pending.
